title: Muskurana Bhi Sadqah Hai
arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
urdu: تمہارا اپنے بھائی کے سامنے مسکرانا بھی تمہارے لیے صدقہ ہے۔
english: Your smile in the face of your brother is charity for you.

steps.title: Aaj Ka Amal Chunein
steps.detail: Aaj kisi se milte waqt khush-akhlaqi, narmi aur muskurahat ke sath pesh aayein.

steps.title: Jar Mein Mark Karein
steps.detail: Amal mukammal karne ke baad is card ko read/completed mark karein.

steps.title: Mahaul Mein Aasani
steps.detail: Ghar, kaam ya safar mein ek khushgawar rawaiya doosron ka bojh halka aur dil khush kar sakta hai.

title: Subhanallahi Wa Bihamdihi Ka Zikr
urdu: اللہ پاک ہے اپنی تعریف کے ساتھ۔
english: Glory be to Allah and praise is to Him.

steps.title: Thora Waqt Nikalein
steps.detail: Din mein kisi bhi waqt sukoon se is tasbeeh ko dohrayein.

steps.title: Agla Card Dekhein
steps.detail: Naye din ya naye tap par agla random reflection card kholein.

steps.title: Dil Ki Be-Chaini Mein Sahar
steps.detail: Jab zehan mein thakan ya pareshani ho to is mukhtasar zikr ke zariye Allah ki taraf ruju karein.

title: Teen Nematon Par Shukr Ka Jaiza
urdu: اگر تم شکر ادا کرو گے تو میں ضرور تمہیں اور زیادہ دوں گا۔
english: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor].

steps.title: 3 Nematein Yaad Karein
steps.detail: Aaj ki sehat, rizq, ahle-khana ya kisi khaas madad ke liye 3 cheezein zehan mein layein.

steps.title: Alhamdulillah Kahein
steps.detail: Dil aur zaban se 'Alhamdulillah' keh kar shukr ada karein.

steps.title: Shukr Ko Amal Mein Dhalein
steps.detail: Nemat ka haq yeh hai ke us ka ghalat istemal na kiya jaye aur zarooratmand ke sath share kiya jaye.

title: Walidain Se Baat Ya Khidmat
arabic: وَقُلْ رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
urdu: اور کہو: اے میرے رب! ان دونوں پر رحم فرما جیسا کہ انہوں نے بچپن میں میری پرورش کی۔
english: And say, 'My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.'

steps.title: Aaj Ka Amal Chunein
steps.detail: Aaj apne walidain ko call karein, un ke pas baith kar baat karein ya un ka koi kaam khushi se karein.

steps.title: Jar Mein Mark Karein
steps.detail: Baat ya khidmat mukammal karne ke baad is card ko read/completed mark karein.

steps.title: Dua Ke Sath Khatima
steps.detail: Un ki sehat, aafiyat aur darjat ki bulandi ke liye dil se dua karein.

title: Istighfar Ki Tasbeeh
urdu: میں اللہ سے معافی مانگتا ہوں جو بہت عظمت والا ہے۔
english: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Supreme.

steps.title: Thora Waqt Nikalein
steps.detail: Kisi bhi waqt sukoon se baith kar 'Astaghfirullah al-Adheem' parhne ka mamool banayein.

steps.title: Agla Card Dekhein
steps.detail: Naye din ya naye tap par agla random reflection card kholein.

steps.title: Dil Ki Safai Aur Umeed
steps.detail: Gunaahon par nidamat ke sath Allah ki bakhshish aur rizq o kaam mein barkat ki umeed rakhein.

title: Ghusse Ke Waqt Rukne Ka Jaiza
urdu: اور غصہ پینے والے اور لوگوں سے درگزر کرنے والے۔
english: And those who restrain anger and who pardon the people.

steps.title: Aaj Ka Mauqa Yaad Karein
steps.detail: Dekhein ke aaj kis waqt ghussa ya chirchira-pan aaya aur us par kis tarah qabu paya ja sakta tha.

steps.title: A'udhu Billah Aur Khamoshi
steps.detail: Agli bar gusse ke waqt 'A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem' parhein aur foran jawab dene se ruk jayein.

steps.title: Muaf Karne Ki Bhalai
steps.detail: Chhoti bhool chook maaf kar ke dil ka bojh kam karein aur Allah ki muhabbat ki umeed rakhein.

title: Raste Se Takleef Hatana
urdu: اور راستے سے تکلیف دہ چیز کو ہٹانا بھی صدقہ ہے۔
english: And removing what is harmful from the road is charity.

steps.title: Aaj Ka Amal Chunein
steps.detail: Ghar, gali, office ya raaste mein koi kachra, pathar ya rukawat ho to use side par hatayein.

steps.title: Jar Mein Mark Karein
steps.detail: Yeh chhoti si khidmat poori karne ke baad is card ko read/completed mark karein.

steps.title: Bhalai Ka Ehsas
steps.detail: Yaad rakhein ke kisi musafir ya chalne wale ko aasani dena bhi ajar ka sabab banta hai.

title: La Hawla Wa La Quwwata Ka Zikr
arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
urdu: نیکی کرنے اور گناہ سے بچنے کی طاقت اللہ ہی کی مدد سے ہے۔
english: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

steps.title: Thora Waqt Nikalein
steps.detail: Jab kisi mushkil kaam ya fikr ka samna ho to sukoon se is kalme ko dohrayein.

steps.title: Agla Card Dekhein
steps.detail: Naye din ya naye tap par agla random reflection card kholein.

steps.title: Asal Sahara Allah Par
steps.detail: Apni kamzori ko samajhte hue Allah ki madad aur tawfeeq par bharosa mazboot karein.

title: Niyyat Aur Waqt Ka Muhasaba
urdu: بے شک اعمال کا دارومدار نیتوں پر ہے۔
english: Verily, actions are according to intentions.

steps.title: Aaj Ke Kaamon Ka Jaiza Lein
steps.detail: Sochein ke aaj jo kaam kiye gaye un mein se kitne sirf Allah ki raza aur khidmat ke liye the.

steps.title: Riyakari Se Bachayein
steps.detail: Agar kisi kaam mein dikhawa ya be-dhyani aayi ho to dil ko samjhayein aur niyyat dobara durust karein.

steps.title: Aane Wale Waqt Ki Niyyat
steps.detail: Agle kaamon aur namazon ke liye pehle se khalis niyyat tayar rakhein.

title: Kisi Ko Achhi Baat Ya Hosla Dena
urdu: اور لوگوں سے اچھی اور بھلی بات کہو۔

steps.title: Aaj Ka Amal Chunein
steps.detail: Aaj kisi pareshan, thake hue ya zarooratmand shaks ko narmi, hosla ya mufeed mashware ke do bol kahein.

steps.title: Jar Mein Mark Karein
steps.detail: Yeh amal karne ke baad is card ko read/completed mark karein.

steps.title: Zaban Ki Hifazat
steps.detail: Aaj ke din gheebat, tanz aur sakht bol se bachne ka khayal rakhein.
